title: Unit Distance Graph Independence Number Bounds

problemStatement.formal: α(G) · χ(G) ≥ |V| where α is independence number, χ is chromatic number
problemStatement.plain: Formalize independence number bounds for unit distance graphs, connecting to the Hadwiger-Nelson problem (5 ≤ χ(R²) ≤ 7).
whyMatters: Connects independence number to chromatic number

proven: disjoint_indep_union: Union of independent sets with no cross-edges
independent_mono: Fewer edges → more independent sets
knownResults.goal: Comprehensive independence number theory for graphs

blockers: greedy_bound remains an axiom (requires algorithmic formalization)
currentState.nextAction: Submit to Aristotle or work on different problem

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Added 9 new theorems (24→33 total). Added chromatic-independence relation (k*α≥n), neighborhood definitions, independent set operations (union, erase, extend), edge monotonicity. 33 theorems, 3 axioms, 0 sorries.
builtItems: unitDistGraph: Unit distance graph on finite plane subsets
neighborhood: Definition N(v) = {u : G.Adj v u} (NEW)
insights: Chromatic-independence relation follows from pigeonhole: each of k color classes has ≤ α elements
Neighborhood definition using Finset.filter matches local degree definition
Independent set operations (union, erase, insert) are key building blocks
Edge monotonicity: fewer edges means more independent sets
mathlibGaps: SimpleGraph.degree uses neighborSet.toFinset, our degree uses filter - not definitionally equal
nextSteps: Submit to Aristotle for automated proof search on axioms

approaches.name: sSup-based independence number + pigeonhole
approaches.description: Define α(G) = sSup{|S| : S independent}, prove duality and α·k≥n via Finset.sum_le_sum
